commands.command: python3 stdin script calling collect.validate on mutated test fixtures (no PHP/SSH)

findings.summary: Non-dict runtime or non-dict record raises AttributeError/TypeError, not ValueError; main() catches only ValueError/TimeoutExpired, so one malformed body aborts the whole 12-process run before the output JSON is written (lost evidence of prior processes). subprocess OSError likewise uncaught.
findings.observed: runtime_not_dict UNCAUGHT AttributeError; row_not_dict UNCAUGHT AttributeError

findings.summary: Blocking-policy check uses only marker_seen from value. wrapper_events (open/stat of xfixture://marker) and marker text in diagnostics are not rejected under legacy/deny, so an attempted/partial external access passes.
exception is untyped (any truthy value satisfies malformed diagnostic requirement); policy_diagnostics type unchecked (string length counted); diagnostics entries unchecked.

policy_return and the expected PHP 8.3 E_DEPRECATED for enabled/legacy libxml_disable_entity_loader are not asserted; stderr retention is captured but not checked. Warning retention is only inferred from error_reporting/internal_errors plus a static test string.
Missing-canary test mutates only 'file' document; no tests for F1-F4; test_prepare does not compare staged bytes to source hashes (verified manually here: match).
